headline: Taiwan Stocks Rise 451 Points This Week; Listed Companies' Total Market Value Hits Record NT$158.56 Trillion | Securities
summary: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 451.14 points, or 0.94%, this week, closing Friday at 48,475.74, a record. Total market value of listed companies reached NT$158.56 trillion, also a record.
why: Taiwan's benchmark index is heavily weighted toward semiconductor companies, so its performance reflects the global chip cycle and foreign investor flows.
